entries.en: Our force prevailed and took the southern bank.
Our force was beaten and fell back to the northern bank.
The armies deadlocked; the gong sounded withdrawal.
The battle is undecided; this record ends here.
The historian writes: at {battle}, not a blade was bloodied.

entries.zh-TW: 遣使入帳，以民心曉之，「{g}」罷兵言和——議和而去，不入陣亡錄。
entries.en: Envoys entered the tent and reasoned with the people's hearts; {g} sheathed arms in accord — retired by treaty, not the roll of the dead.

entries.zh-TW: 陳師疆埸，軍威所懾，「{g}」未交一矢引兵而退——懾服而去，不入陣亡錄。
entries.en: Arrayed at the border, our menace sufficed; {g} withdrew without an arrow loosed — cowed, not slain.

entries.zh-TW: 內應發於敵帳，「{g}」眾叛親離——變節投誠，不入陣亡錄。
entries.en: Insiders turned within the enemy camp; {g}, abandoned by all, defected — not the roll of the dead.
{g} furled the banners and stilled the drums — not the roll of the dead.

entries.zh-TW: 彼之陣法，似針對我軍慣用「{habit}」
entries.en: Their formation seems aimed at our habit of {habit}
